items.title: a round of Graveyard Pinball
items.blurb: A free-to-play 3D pinball game in the browser: flip a chrome ball through a haunted graveyard table with coffin slingshots, a skull-crypt portal, mini games and a dot-matrix display. Real-time WebGPU, Three.js and TSL by Anderson Mancini.

items.title: explains more about how it works here
items.blurb: A free Halloween pinball for the browser: a 2D physics world drawn in 3D, a ball that never tunnels, and a bot that plays hundreds of balls to tune the table.
